name: aikeys
description: Small CLI for AI-agent-safe API key storage, retrieval, scanning, and template rendering.

scripts.smoke: AIKEYS_HOME=.tmp/aikeys AIKEYS_PASSWORD=test-password node bin/aikeys.js setup --force && printf 'secret-value\n' | AIKEYS_HOME=.tmp/aikeys AIKEYS_PASSWORD=test-password node bin/aikeys.js set demo/key v1 && AIKEYS_HOME=.tmp/aikeys AIKEYS_PASSWORD=test-password node bin/aikeys.js get demo/key v1
